prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: mobile-first web app direction comp, portrait iPhone screen
Primary request: a shippable Open Calory Tracker home screen in a Market Receipt Ledger visual system, where each food is a line item in a private daily receipt whose totals remain traceable.
Structure: slim top bar and centered date; a continuous vertical receipt sheet with large running calories total; macro totals as aligned ledger columns; food events as time-stamped receipt line items; a narrow clipped water tally strip alongside; thumb-reachable Add food and Add water controls at bottom.
Subject/content: Saturday, August 29; Mock data label; 1,420 / 2,050 kcal; Greek yogurt with blueberries 320 kcal 8:12 AM; Turkey & avocado sandwich 540 kcal 12:36 PM; water 40 / 80 fl oz; protein 72 / 120 g; carbs 131 / 230 g; fat 44 / 70 g; fiber Incomplete; USDA FoodData Central attribution.
Style/medium: realistic polished product UI, not concept art. Soft pale receipt stock, near-black ink, deep tomato-red rubber date stamps, green highlighter bands, produce-scale numerals, perforated edges used sparingly, tactile but clean.
Composition/framing: full portrait 9:16 app viewport, no device frame; continuous reading flow; the receipt is the interface rather than a white card floating on a generic background.
Constraints: mobile web app; English; practical accessible hierarchy; no photographs, no illustrations, no progress rings, no generic wellness cards, no gamification, no streaks, no badges, no medical claims, no fake logos, no watermark; render provided labels accurately and do not invent claims.
